digest.component_or_area: linting / code quality sweeping (ARG violations across src/rebar)
propositions: 72 ARG violations (56 ARG001, 14 ARG002, 2 ARG005) are reported by ruff in src/rebar; pyproject.toml:375 does not select ARG family, leaving accepted-but-unused parameters undetected

Cluster-1 reconciler leaf handlers (10 sites across apply_inbound/apply_outbound) accept client and repo_root as parameters but never read them; naive rename breaks runtime dispatch (client is unconditional in _leaf_kwargs) and string-introspection gating (repo_root checked by name at dispatch time)

Cluster-2 OutboundMapper Protocol implementations (7 sites: jira_datacenter/backend.py, jira_family/outbound_mapper.py) have keyword-pinned parameters by Protocol contract and keyword call sites; renaming breaks the Protocol structural match and caller contract
Three tracked real defects (timeout_s, close_reason, acli_cmd) are left in place with residual ARG violations because they represent accepted-then-silently-dropped values that should be consumed

Post-sweep ARG violations reduce to 21 irreducible residuals (2 tracked defects + 7 Protocol-pinned + 12 keyword/doc-pinned), enabling ARG as a new gate is blocked by RUF100 unused-noqa collision (pyproject selects RUF with RUF100 ON but not ARG)
